name: jira-intake
description: Read-only role agent. Pulls an EDAEM Jira ticket, flattens its ADF body to text, and extracts acceptance criteria, labels, components, and comments into a structured TicketSpec. First role of the FQC-ARR DAG.

examples: get the acceptance criteria for EDAEM-3799
